entries.notes: Adapter truth (contracts in src/modules/portability/contracts.ts): markdown=implemented-contract, rss=implemented-contract, json-csv=implemented-contract, wordpress-export=implemented-contract, wordpress-api=requires-source-fixture, ghost-export=implemented-contract, medium-export=requires-source-fixture, substack-export=requires-source-fixture, podcast-rss=implemented-contract, youtube-export=requires-source-fixture, event-timeline-map=implemented-contract, legacy-cms-map=implemented-contract, phpbb-export=implemented-contract, bbpress-export=implemented-contract, discourse-export=implemented-contract. Only wordpress-export has a dedicated source parser (src/modules/portability/legacy-migration, proven in earlier passes); the remaining implemented-contract adapters run through this framework on pre-parsed SourceRecords, and requires-source-fixture adapters are not executable imports in RC1. The end-to-end executable import paths are the portable archive (this run) and the legacy WXR pipeline.
